```{r}
library(xgboost)
library(data.table)

# Step 1: Reformat Column Names
names(sound_pollutant_met_data) <- gsub(" ", "_", names(sound_pollutant_met_data))

# Updated predictors list after reformatting
predictors <- c(
  "LAFmax", "LAFmin", "LCpeak", "LAeq", "LCeq", "LZeq_12.5Hz", 
  "LZeq_16Hz", "LZeq_20Hz", "LZeq_25Hz", "LZeq_31.5Hz", "LZeq_40Hz", 
  "LZeq_50Hz", "LZeq_63Hz", "LZeq_80Hz", "LZeq_100Hz", "LZeq_125Hz", 
  "LZeq_160Hz", "LZeq_200Hz", "LZeq_250Hz", "LZeq_315Hz", "LZeq_400Hz", 
  "LZeq_500Hz", "LZeq_630Hz", "LZeq_800Hz", "LZeq_1kHz", "LZeq_1.25kHz", 
  "LZeq_1.6kHz", "LZeq_2kHz", "LZeq_2.5kHz", "LZeq_3.15kHz", "LZeq_4kHz", 
  "LZeq_5kHz", "LZeq_6.3kHz", "LZeq_8kHz", "LZeq_10kHz", "LZeq_12.5kHz", 
  "LZeq_16kHz"
)

response <- "no2"
```

```{r}
# Split the dataset
set.seed(42)
n <- nrow(sound_pollutant_met_data)
train_index <- sample(1:n, size = 0.6 * n)
temp_index <- setdiff(1:n, train_index)
valid_index <- sample(temp_index, size = 0.5 * length(temp_index))
test_index <- setdiff(temp_index, valid_index)

train_data <- sound_pollutant_met_data[train_index, ]
valid_data <- sound_pollutant_met_data[valid_index, ]
test_data <- sound_pollutant_met_data[test_index, ]
```

```{r}
head(train_data)
```
```{r}
filtered_train_data <- train_data %>% 
  filter(nox <= 50)
hist(filtered_train_data$nox)
```

```{r}
dtrain <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(train_data[, predictors]), label = train_data[, response])
dvalid <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(valid_data[, predictors]), label = valid_data[, response])
dtest <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(test_data[, predictors]), label = test_data[, response])

# Define parameter grid
param_grid <- list(
  eta = c(0.01, 0.1, 0.2),
  max_depth = c(6, 8, 10),
  subsample = c(0.8, 1.0),
  colsample_bytree = c(0.8, 1.0),
  gamma = c(0, 0.1, 1)
)

# Cross-validation for parameter tuning
best_param <- list()
best_rmse <- Inf

for (eta in param_grid$eta) {
  for (max_depth in param_grid$max_depth) {
    for (subsample in param_grid$subsample) {
      for (colsample_bytree in param_grid$colsample_bytree) {
        for (gamma in param_grid$gamma) {
          params <- list(
            objective = "reg:squarederror",
            eta = eta,
            max_depth = max_depth,
            subsample = subsample,
            colsample_bytree = colsample_bytree,
            gamma = gamma
          )
          cv <- xgb.cv(params = params, data = dtrain, nrounds = 200, nfold = 3, 
                       metrics = "rmse", early_stopping_rounds = 10, verbose = 0)
          min_rmse <- min(cv$evaluation_log$test_rmse_mean)
          if (min_rmse < best_rmse) {
            best_rmse <- min_rmse
            best_param <- params
            best_nrounds <- cv$best_iteration
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
# Fit the final model
final_model <- xgb.train(params = best_param, data = dtrain, nrounds = best_nrounds, 
                         watchlist = list(train = dtrain, valid = dvalid), 
                         early_stopping_rounds = 10, verbose = 1)

# Evaluate on test set
preds <- predict(final_model, dtest)
test_rmse <- sqrt(mean((preds - test_data[, response])^2))

list(best_param = best_param, best_nrounds = best_nrounds, test_rmse = test_rmse)

```


```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(caret)
library(xgboost)
set.seed(301)

# Define predictor and response variables, replacing spaces with underscores
predictors <- c("LAFmax", "LAFmin", "LCpeak", "LAeq", "LCeq", "LZeq_12.5Hz", "LZeq_16Hz", "LZeq_20Hz", 
                "LZeq_25Hz", "LZeq_31.5Hz", "LZeq_40Hz", "LZeq_50Hz", "LZeq_63Hz", "LZeq_80Hz", "LZeq_100Hz", 
                "LZeq_125Hz", "LZeq_160Hz", "LZeq_200Hz", "LZeq_250Hz", "LZeq_315Hz", "LZeq_400Hz", "LZeq_500Hz", 
                "LZeq_630Hz", "LZeq_800Hz", "LZeq_1kHz", "LZeq_1.25kHz", "LZeq_1.6kHz", "LZeq_2kHz", "LZeq_2.5kHz", 
                "LZeq_3.15kHz", "LZeq_4kHz", "LZeq_5kHz", "LZeq_6.3kHz", "LZeq_8kHz", "LZeq_10kHz", "LZeq_12.5kHz", 
                "LZeq_16kHz")
response <- "no2"

# Create a copy of the dataset for model processing
model_data <- sound_pollutant_met_data
names(model_data) <- gsub(" ", "_", names(model_data))

# Split data into training (60%), validation (20%), and test (20%) sets
trainIndex <- createDataPartition(model_data[[response]], p = 0.6, list = FALSE)
train_data <- model_data[trainIndex, ]
temp_data <- model_data[-trainIndex, ]

validationIndex <- createDataPartition(temp_data[[response]], p = 0.5, list = FALSE)
validation_data <- temp_data[validationIndex, ]
test_data <- temp_data[-validationIndex, ]

# Convert datasets to matrix format for XGBoost
train_matrix <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(train_data[, predictors]), label = train_data[[response]])
validation_matrix <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(validation_data[, predictors]), label = validation_data[[response]])
test_matrix <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(test_data[, predictors]), label = test_data[[response]])

# Define training parameters and control grid
train_control <- trainControl(method = "cv", number = 10, search = "grid")

# Parameter tuning grid for XGBoost
tune_grid <- expand.grid(
  max_depth = c(3, 5, 7, 9),
  nrounds = (1:10) * 50,
  eta = 0.3,
  gamma = 0,
  subsample = 1,
  min_child_weight = 1,
  colsample_bytree = 0.8
)

# Train the XGBoost model
optimal_xgb_model <- train(
  form = as.formula(paste(response, "~", paste(predictors, collapse = "+"))),
  data = train_data,
  method = "xgbTree",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = tune_grid,
  na.action = na.omit
)

# Evaluate the model on the validation and test data
validation_pred <- predict(optimal_xgb_model, newdata = validation_data)
test_pred <- predict(optimal_xgb_model, newdata = test_data)

# Calculate RMSE for validation and test sets
validation_rmse <- sqrt(mean((validation_pred - validation_data[[response]])^2))
test_rmse <- sqrt(mean((test_pred - test_data[[response]])^2))

# Output RMSE results
print(paste("Validation RMSE:", validation_rmse))
print(paste("Test RMSE:", test_rmse))

```



















```{r}
set.seed(42)

# Assuming sound_pollutant_met_data is already loaded
data <- sound_pollutant_met_data

# Create indices for splitting
train_index <- createDataPartition(data$no2, p = 0.6, list = FALSE)
train_data <- data[train_index, ]

remaining_data <- data[-train_index, ]
validation_index <- createDataPartition(remaining_data$no2, p = 0.375, list = FALSE)  # 0.375 * 0.4 = 0.15 for validation
valid_data <- remaining_data[validation_index, ]
test_data <- remaining_data[-validation_index, ]

# Remove any unused data
rm(data, remaining_data, train_index, validation_index)

```

```{r}
# Define predictor variables
predictors <- c("LAFmax", "LAFmin", "LCpeak", "LAeq", "LCeq", "LZeq 12.5Hz", "LZeq 16Hz", "LZeq 20Hz", 
                "LZeq 25Hz", "LZeq 31.5Hz", "LZeq 40Hz", "LZeq 50Hz", "LZeq 63Hz", "LZeq 80Hz", "LZeq 100Hz", 
                "LZeq 125Hz", "LZeq 160Hz", "LZeq 200Hz", "LZeq 250Hz", "LZeq 315Hz", "LZeq 400Hz", "LZeq 500Hz", 
                "LZeq 630Hz", "LZeq 800Hz", "LZeq 1kHz", "LZeq 1.25kHz", "LZeq 1.6kHz", "LZeq 2kHz", "LZeq 2.5kHz", 
                "LZeq 3.15kHz", "LZeq 4kHz", "LZeq 5kHz", "LZeq 6.3kHz", "LZeq 8kHz", "LZeq 10kHz", "LZeq 12.5kHz", 
                "LZeq 16kHz")

# Convert data frames to matrix form for xgboost
train_matrix <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(train_data[, predictors]), label = train_data$no2)
valid_matrix <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(valid_data[, predictors]), label = valid_data$no2)
test_matrix <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(test_data[, predictors]))

```

```{r}
# Parameter grid for tuning
param_grid <- list(
  max_depth = c(6, 8, 10),
  eta = c(0.1, 0.05, 0.01),
  subsample = c(0.7, 0.8),
  colsample_bytree = c(0.7, 0.8)
)

# Define number of rounds and early stopping criteria
nrounds <- 1000
early_stopping <- 10

# Training the model and tuning using validation data
best_model <- xgb.cv(
  params = param_grid,
  data = train_matrix,
  nrounds = nrounds,
  nfold = 5,
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  metrics = "rmse",
  early_stopping_rounds = early_stopping,
  maximize = FALSE,
  watchlist = list(validation = valid_matrix)
)

```
